integrity: Exact six-equation derivation, constructive necessity-and-sufficiency proof, and standalone enumerator replayed over seven finite fields.
scientific_limitations: Earlier 2019 complex classification covers the complex specialization. No general classification of all evolution algebras, scheme structures, or global priority is claimed; finite enumerations supplement an all-field algebraic proof.
scientific_scope: All fields; exact k-linear weight-lambda Rota–Baxter operators on the two-dimensional cyclic perfect evolution algebra, with characteristic-three specialization and finite-field counts.
title: Cyclotomic descent and the characteristic-three jump for Rota–Baxter operators on a cyclic evolution algebra
